name: Superstition
overview: Scripture clearly condemns reliance on superstitions and occult practices, warning believers not to seek out familiar spirits or wizards, as seen in Leviticus 19:31. The Lord forbids divination, witchcraft, and other forms of sorcery, emphasizing the importance of worshiping Him alone rather than celestial bodies or false gods (Deuteronomy 4:19; 18:10). Even powerful rulers like Nebuchadnezzar recognized the Spirit of God upon Daniel, distinguishing true divine power from superstitious beliefs (Daniel 4:8-9). This teaching calls Christians to trust in the sovereignty of God rather than in misguided fears or human inventions.
